title: 第16章 饲欲斩愿第17章 牛马啊
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 云梦舟内，欧阳夫人拉着赵归涯的手不放：“小未啊，这几年你跑哪野了？你母亲担心的都快把修仙界翻了个底朝天！”
赵归涯无语：“得了吧，姐。
我妈那分明是没有牛马帮她干活找牛马呢！”
欧阳夫人闻言，忍不住‘噗嗤’一笑，抬手轻拍赵归涯的脑袋：“你这孩子，怎么这么说你母亲！”
赵归涯撇撇嘴：“本来就是嘛。
我哥跑路我六岁那年，她老人家把我拎到欲宗大殿，当着各门长老的面说‘这孩子天赋不错，你们随便造，就别来烦我了’，然后拍拍屁股自己跑出去玩了。”
欧阳夫人捂嘴笑：“行了，要怪你哥，要不是你哥拜完师之后就宣布闭关，你母亲也不会拿你挡灾。”
云梦舟的会客厅内，欧阳夫人拉着赵归涯絮絮叨叨说了半天，终于放他去休息。
赵归涯如蒙大赦，捞起在一旁睡的极香的风翼一溜烟跑到了飞舟甲板上透气。
楚安芷正倚在船舷边欣赏云海，见徒弟过来，忍不住打趣道：“怎么，被念叨怕了？”
赵归涯倚在栏杆上，摸着风翼软乎乎的毛，长长叹了口气：“别提了，我姐那嘴巴我妈都怕。”
正说着，欧阳叙白端着果盘走了过来：“师姑，未来，吃水果不？飞舟上的灵果可甜了。”
楚安芷顺手抓了个灵桃啃起来：“嗯，好甜。”
欧阳叙白凑过来神秘兮兮地说：“对了，我家老爷子让我问你，要不要换个舱房？搬到他书房那边，方便商量事情。”
“大可不必。”
赵归涯摆摆手，“你们欧阳家的事情我可不帮忙处理。”
欧阳叙白撇撇嘴：“小舅，你也太见外了。
老爷子他就是想找你分担分担。”
三人正说笑间，柳清漪风风火火地跑过来：“师姑！
小未！
小白？你们快来看，飞舟上有好多新奇玩意儿！
竟然连温泉都有！”
“看来你们逛的差不多了，连温泉都找到了。”
赵归涯惊奇。
“啊，未来你怎么知道的？”
欧阳叙白震惊。
“这个飞舟是我给你母亲送的生辰礼物，我能不知道吗？”
“啊？呵呵呵，原来是这样啊。”
欧阳叙白一脸尴尬。
柳清漪眼睛亮晶晶的，拉着楚安芷的胳膊晃了晃：“师姑，那温泉是不是超棒，咱们一起去泡呀。”
楚安芷还没来得及回答，赵归涯就开口了：“一起去泡泡，温泉对修炼有好处，还能疏通经脉”
content_en:
In the Yunmeng Boat, Mrs. Ouyang held Zhao Guiya's hand and said, "Xiao Wei, where have you been in the past few years? Your mother is so worried that she has almost turned the world of immortality upside down!"
Zhao Guiya was speechless: "Come on, sister.
My mother obviously didn’t have any cows or horses to help her work and found cows and horses! "
Hearing this, Mrs. Ouyang couldn't help but laugh, raised her hand and patted Zhao Guiya on the head: "You kid, why do you say that about your mother!"
Zhao Guiya curled his lips: "That's right.
When my brother ran away and I was six years old, she took me to the main hall of the Yu Sect and said in front of the elders of the various sects, "This child is very talented. You can make him whatever you want, so don't bother me." Then he patted his butt and ran out to play. "
Mrs. Ouyang covered her mouth and smiled: "Okay, let's blame your brother. If your brother hadn't announced his retreat after becoming a master, your mother would not have used you to ward off disaster."
In Yun Mengzhou's living room, Mrs. Ouyang took Zhao Guiya and talked for a long time, and finally let him rest.
Zhao Guiya felt like he was being pardoned. He picked up the fragrant Feng Yi who was sleeping beside him and ran to the deck of the flying boat for some fresh air.
Chu Anzhi was leaning on the side of the boat admiring the sea of clouds. When she saw her apprentice approaching, she couldn't help but joked: "Why, are you afraid of being talked about?"
Zhao Guiya leaned on the railing, touched Fengyi's soft fur, and sighed: "Don't mention it, my sister's mouth is even scary to my mother."
Just as he was talking, Ouyang Xubai came over with a fruit plate: "Senior aunt, do you want to eat fruit in the future? The spiritual fruit on the flying boat is so sweet."
Chu Anzhi grabbed a spiritual peach and gnawed it: "Well, it's so sweet."
Ouyang Xubai came over and said mysteriously: "By the way, my old man asked me to ask you if you want to change the cabin? Move to his study room so that we can discuss things more easily."
"No need to."
Zhao Guiya waved his hand and said, "I won't help you deal with your Ouyang family's affairs."
Ouyang Xubai curled his lips: "Uncle, you are too outspoken.
The old man just wants to share the burden with you. "
"Ha!"
While the three of them were talking and laughing, Liu Qingyi ran over in a hurry: "Senior Sister!
Xiaowei!
Novice? Come and take a look, there are many novelties on the flying boat!
There is even a hot spring! "
"It seems that you have almost done your shopping and even found the hot springs."
Zhao Guiya was surprised.
"Ah, how do you know the future?"
Ouyang Xubai was shocked.
"This flying boat is a birthday gift from me to your mother. Can I not know?"
"Huh? Hahaha, so that's it."
Ouyang Xubai looked embarrassed.
Liu Qingyi's eyes were bright, and she took Chu Anzhi's arm and shook it: "Sister, isn't that hot spring awesome? Let's go take a bath together."
Before Chu Anzhi could answer, Zhao Guiya spoke: "Let's go take a bath together. The hot springs are good for cultivation and can also clear the meridians."
title_en: Chapter 16: Desire to cut off the wish Chapter 17: Cows and horses
